links.surface: أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِی نَصْر

notes: «ره» is an honorific and left out. «أَبِی» is the compiler's father (relation). «أَحَدِهِمَا» (one of the two Imams, unnamed) is the last link: «قُلْتُ لَهُ» makes him the one asked. «أَبِیهِ» is Ibn Mihran's father, named only by relation. Offsets approximate.
